welcome.title: Welcome to GitBaro
welcome.description: A simple Git client with per-repo GitHub account management
welcome.signInDescription: Connect your GitHub account to get started
welcome.cloneDescription: Clone a repository from GitHub or a URL
welcome.openLocalDescription: Open an existing local Git repository

changes.title: Changes
changes.discardConfirmMessage: Discard all changes to "{{file}}"? This cannot be undone.

commit.subjectTooLong: Subject line exceeds {{max}} characters — consider shortening it.

history.title: History
history.author: Author
history.checkoutConfirm: Check out commit {{shortId}}? This detaches HEAD from any branch.

reset.title: Reset to {{shortId}}
reset.softDesc: Move HEAD only. Staged changes and working tree are kept.
reset.mixedDesc: Move HEAD and unstage changes. Working tree is kept.
reset.hardDesc: Move HEAD and discard all staged and working-tree changes.
reset.hardWarning: A hard reset permanently discards uncommitted changes.

branch.title: Branches
branch.name: Branch name
branch.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}?
branch.deleteUnmergedWarning: This branch has not been fully merged. Unmerged commits may be lost.
branch.inWorktree: Checked out in worktree {{name}} · click to open
branch.defaultBranchDesc: The default branch in your repository. Pick this to start on something new that's not dependent on your current branch.
branch.currentBranchDesc: The currently checked out branch. Pick this if you need to build on work done on this branch.
branch.uncommittedChanges: You have changes on this branch. What would you like to do with them?
branch.leaveChangesDesc: Your in-progress work will be stashed on this branch for you to return to later.
branch.bringChangesDesc: Your in-progress work will follow you to the new branch.

gh.installDescription: GitBaro requires the GitHub CLI (gh) for authentication. Install it to continue.
gh.versionTooOld: GitHub CLI needs to be updated
gh.upgradeDescription: GitBaro requires gh version 2.40 or higher. Please upgrade.

detected.title: GitHub Accounts Found
detected.description: We found accounts logged in via GitHub CLI on this machine. Select the accounts you'd like to use with GitBaro.
detected.signInNew: Sign in with a different account

repo.cloneDescription: Clone a repository from GitHub or a remote URL
repo.initDescription: Initialize a new Git repository in a folder
repo.addDescription: Add an existing local Git repository
repo.accountNoAccess: This account cannot access the repository
repo.accountReadOnly: Read-only — no push permission for this account

contextMenu.removeConfirmDetail: Remove "{{name}}" from the list? The repository will not be deleted from disk.

repo.selectDefaultAccountDesc: Choose the default GitHub account to use with this repository.

settings.title: Settings
settings.editorDescription: Choose the editor to open files with
settings.editorNotSet: No default editor configured. Please select one in Settings.
settings.terminalDescription: Choose the terminal app to use
settings.aiDescription: Choose the AI CLI to use with repositories

diff.noSelection: Select a file to view changes
diff.selectFile: Select a changed file to view its diff
diff.selectCommit: Select a commit to view its details
diff.tooLarge: File too large to preview (exceeds 10 MB)
diff.highlightDisabled: Syntax highlighting disabled for performance ({{lines}} lines).

mdDiff.timeout: The document is too large to render. Falling back to unified view.
mdDiff.failed: Could not render the document view. Falling back to unified view.

sync.fetchDescription: Download objects and refs from remote
sync.readOnlyDesc: No push permission for this repo
sync.publishBranchDesc: Push this branch to remote to share with others
sync.noUpstreamError: This branch has no upstream. Please publish the branch first.
sync.forcePushWarning: This will overwrite remote history. This action cannot be undone.

error.auth: Authentication failed. Please sign in again.
error.rateLimit: Rate limit exceeded. Try again in {{time}}.
error.gitNotFound: Git is not installed. Please install Xcode Command Line Tools.

mergeRecovery.resolveHint: Resolve and stage {{count}} conflicted file(s), then continue.
mergeRecovery.readyHint: All conflicts resolved. You can continue the operation.

compare.title: Compare Branches
compare.detachedHead: Branch comparison is not available in detached HEAD state
compare.branchNotFound: Branch not found — it may have been deleted
compare.incomingTooltip_one: {{count}} commit from {{branch}} that you can merge
compare.incomingTooltip_other: {{count}} commits from {{branch}} that you can merge
compare.selectorIncomingTooltip_one: {{count}} commit you can pull from this branch
compare.selectorIncomingTooltip_other: {{count}} commits you can pull from this branch

merge.title: Merge
merge.dirtyWorkdir: You have uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them before merging.
merge.nothingToMerge: Nothing to merge — current branch is up to date
merge.upToDate: Your branch is up to date with {{branch}}

preCheck.fastForward: Fast-forward available — no merge commit needed
preCheck.previewSelectFile: Select a file to view conflicts
preCheck.previewLegendOurs: Lines only in current branch (will be lost if overwritten)
preCheck.previewLegendTheirs: Lines only in incoming branch (will be added after merge)
preCheck.previewConflictBothModified: Both branches modified this section differently
preCheck.previewConflictOursOnly: Current branch has changes that incoming branch removed
preCheck.previewConflictTheirsOnly: Incoming branch added changes not present in current branch

stash.title: Stash
stash.noStashesDescription: Stash your changes to save them for later
stash.selectStash: Select a stash to view its changes
stash.applyDescription: Apply stash changes without removing from list
stash.popDescription: Apply stash changes and remove from list
stash.dropConfirmDescription: This will permanently delete this stash. This action cannot be undone.

actions.title: Actions
actions.noRunsDescription: No GitHub Actions runs found for this repository
actions.selectRun: Select a run to view details
actions.noRemote: No remote repository to check Actions
actions.noAccount: Connect a GitHub account to view Actions

unchecked.notApplicable: Nothing of this kind in the change
unchecked.missingArtifact: A required file was not found

scope.label: Scan scope
scope.noFindings: Nothing was flagged by the rules that ran. This is not a pass.
scope.nothingRan: No rule ran on this change.

settings.title: Verification rules
settings.description: Every rule can be turned on or off on its own. A rule you turn off is listed as not checked — never as passed.
settings.plannedNote: Not implemented yet — always reported as not checked.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load the rule list: {{error}}

symbolIndex.title: Symbol index
symbolIndex.note: Needed to check duplicate code, unused code and blast radius. Without it those checks stay unchecked.
symbolIndex.skipped: {{count}} files the index could not read — their symbols are not used by any check

hooks.title: Agent hooks
hooks.note: GitBaro records what Claude Code did, directly. Immune to session-log format changes, but it modifies ~/.claude/settings.json.

dialog.title: What will be installed
dialog.backup: {{path}} is copied to a timestamped backup before it is modified.

hooks.needsUpgrade: The installed hooks are older than this build. Reinstall to record the current fields.

settingsState.missing: {{path}} does not exist yet — installing creates it.
settingsState.malformed: {{path}} is not valid JSON. Fix it first; installing would overwrite it.

review.staleHint: This file changed after you reviewed it, so it went back to not reviewed.
review.markFailed: Could not save the review state: {{error}}

queue.unresolved: {{count}} more not loaded in this view

pushGate.title: Before you push
pushGate.tangled: {{count}} touch enough files that a clean revert is unlikely
pushGate.displayOnly: This is a summary, not a gate. Pushing stays available.
pushGate.confirmDanger: A danger-level signal was found in these commits. Push anyway?
pushGate.failed: Could not read the push summary: {{error}}

ledger.title: Verification ledger
ledger.description: Records what was checked on a commit in local git notes. Off by default and never pushed.

evidence.title: Test run evidence

freshness.staleUnknown: the tree changed since — evidence expired
freshness.absent: No test run has been recorded for this working tree

evidence.noCommand: No test command is configured for this repository
evidence.claimNote: This records what actually ran, not what a summary said ran.

coverage.title: Coverage of added lines
coverage.unmapped: {{count}} changed files are not in the report — their coverage is unknown
coverage.fileUnmapped: This file is not in the coverage report, so its coverage is unknown
coverage.absent: No coverage report was found, so coverage is unknown
coverage.qualityNote: Coverage only proves a line ran. It says nothing about whether a test would catch a defect.
coverage.qualityNotChecked: This coverage means the code ran, not that it was verified. Test quality was not checked separately.

session.firstPromptNote: The prompt the agent could not rewrite. Compare it with what actually changed.
session.noPrompt: No prompt was recorded for this session
session.truncated: This log was too large to read in full, so these numbers are a partial view.
session.skippedRecords: {{count}} records could not be read, so these numbers are a partial view.
session.readLessNote: The agent changed this file without reading it in this session. Read it yourself first.
session.viaBashNote: Changed by a shell command, so /rewind cannot restore it.
session.subagentNote: A subagent made these edits. The main transcript does not show how it got there.
session.compactionNote: Edited after the context was compacted, so the agent no longer had the earlier discussion.
session.churnNote: The agent edited this file repeatedly, which usually means it was unsure. Read it before the files it got right first time.
session.commandOutcomeNote: A command that exited 0 ran without error. It does not mean the result was correct.
session.cumulativeDiffEmpty: This session could not be tied to a commit, so its cumulative change is unknown
session.cumulativeDiffNote: The net change across the whole session, not the individual edits.

link.title: Related session
link.estimateNote: Estimated from timing and paths. Treat it as a guess, not a record.

session.partialSignalsNote: The log was only read in part, so these signals are incomplete.

dependencies.title: Dependency check
dependencies.offline: Checked against the manifest and lockfile only. Nothing left this machine.
dependencies.allowRegistry: Also check the package registry (sends package names over the network)

error.sessionUnreadable: That session log could not be read: {{error}}

structuralDiff.title: Structural (AST) diff
structuralDiff.description: Compares syntax trees so formatting, renames and moved code stop hiding the real change.

testSkipAdded.title: Test skip added
testSkipAdded.description: A new it.skip, xit, test.todo, #[ignore] or @pytest.mark.skip was introduced.

testFileDeleted.title: Test file deleted
testFileDeleted.description: A test file was removed in this change.

assertionRemoved.title: Assertions removed
assertionRemoved.description: The number of expect/assert lines in a test file went down.

vacuousAssertion.title: Vacuous assertion
vacuousAssertion.description: An assertion that passes for almost any value, such as toBeDefined() or toBeTruthy().

mockOnlyAssertion.title: Mock-only assertion
mockOnlyAssertion.description: The test asserts on a value its own mock returned, so no production code runs.

noAssertionTest.title: Test without assertions
noAssertionTest.description: A test function that runs code but never asserts anything.

broadExceptionAssertion.title: Broad exception assertion
broadExceptionAssertion.description: The test expects a base Exception with no concrete type or message.

assertionRoulette.title: Assertion roulette
assertionRoulette.description: Many unlabelled assertions in one test make a failure hard to pinpoint.

hallucinatedDependency.title: Dependency not found
hallucinatedDependency.description: An added package could not be found in the registry or in the lockfile.

suspiciousNewDependency.title: Newly published or rarely used dependency
suspiciousNewDependency.description: An added package was published very recently or has very few downloads.

verificationBypassed.title: Verification bypass added
verificationBypassed.description: A --no-verify flag or an equivalent lint/type-check suppression was added.

typeEscapeHatchAdded.title: Type escape hatch added
typeEscapeHatchAdded.description: A new as any, @ts-ignore or # type: ignore was introduced.

emptyCatchAdded.title: Empty catch added
emptyCatchAdded.description: A catch block was added that swallows the error without handling it.

unsafeUnwrapAdded.title: Unchecked unwrap added
unsafeUnwrapAdded.description: A new unwrap()/expect() panics instead of propagating the error.

scopeDrift.title: Scope drift
scopeDrift.description: Files changed outside the scope the commit message declares.

reinventedFunction.title: Reinvented function
reinventedFunction.description: A newly added function closely resembles one that already exists in the repository.

orphanCode.title: Orphan code
orphanCode.description: A newly added export is called from nowhere in the repository.

blastRadius.title: Blast radius
blastRadius.description: Lists the call sites affected by a changed signature.

publicExportDeleted.title: Public export deleted
publicExportDeleted.description: An exported symbol was removed — call sites outside this diff may break.

errorHandlingDeleted.title: Error handling deleted
errorHandlingDeleted.description: A try/catch, error branch or Result handling was removed.

validationDeleted.title: Validation deleted
validationDeleted.description: An input check or schema validation was removed.

testEvidenceMissing.title: No test run recorded
testEvidenceMissing.description: No test run has ever been recorded for this repository.

testEvidenceStale.title: Test evidence expired
testEvidenceStale.description: The tree changed after the last recorded run, so the result no longer describes this code.

testEvidenceFailed.title: Recorded test run failed
testEvidenceFailed.description: The last recorded test run for this tree did not pass.

uncoveredNewLines.title: Added lines never executed
uncoveredNewLines.description: Lines this change adds are not covered by the parsed coverage report.

mutationScore.title: Mutation score
mutationScore.description: Shows the mutation score of changed files — a stronger signal than line coverage.

invariantViolation.title: Declared invariant violated
invariantViolation.description: A refactor:, perf: or docs: commit changed behaviour that its type promises to keep.

claimMismatch.title: Claim does not match the diff
claimMismatch.description: The commit message claims something the diff does not show.

blindReviewMode.title: Blind review mode
blindReviewMode.description: Shows the diff before any flags or summaries, on purpose.

readLessEdit.title: Edited without reading
readLessEdit.description: The session edited this file without reading or searching it first. Use it to prioritise review, not as a warning.

testFailureThenTestEdited.title: Test edited after a failure
testFailureThenTestEdited.description: The session saw a test fail and then changed the test rather than the code.

testsNeverRunInSession.title: Tests never run in the session
testsNeverRunInSession.description: No test command appears anywhere in this session's command history.

hookBypassCommand.title: Hook bypass command
hookBypassCommand.description: The session ran a command that skips hooks or force-pushes, such as --no-verify or push -f.

unrewindableChange.title: Change outside /rewind's reach
unrewindableChange.description: The file was changed through a shell command, which checkpoints do not restore.

subagentEdit.title: Edited by a subagent
subagentEdit.description: A subagent changed this file; only its summary reached the main context.

postCompactionEdit.title: Edited after context compaction
postCompactionEdit.description: The change came after the session compacted its context, so earlier instructions may have been dropped.

repeatedEdit.title: Repeatedly re-edited
repeatedEdit.description: The same file was edited many times in one session — a trial-and-error signal.

promptScopeDrift.title: Outside the original prompt's scope
promptScopeDrift.description: Paths changed that the first user prompt never mentioned.

staleRulesInjected.title: Session received outdated rules
staleRulesInjected.description: The CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md content injected into the session differs from the file on disk.

hookCollector.title: Hook-based session recording
hookCollector.description: Collects tool events through agent CLI hooks instead of parsing session files.

tangledCommit.title: Tangled commit
tangledCommit.description: One commit mixes unrelated concerns, so it cannot be reverted cleanly.

revertUnsafe.title: Revert would not be clean
revertUnsafe.description: Later commits depend on this one, so reverting it will conflict.

agentTrailerMismatch.title: Agent trailer does not match the session
agentTrailerMismatch.description: The commit trailers and the session log disagree about who edited this commit.

subCommitBisect.title: Sub-commit bisect
subCommitBisect.description: Bisects inside a single commit by applying only a subset of its files.

syntax.needsIndex: Duplicate code, unused code and blast radius have not been checked yet

hookBypass.title: Committed while skipping the hooks
hookBypass.subtitle: The agent bypassed pre-commit hooks with --no-verify or similar. It leaves no trace in the code, so only the session log shows it.

suppression.title: Silenced a check inside the code
suppression.subtitle: Instead of fixing what the type checker or linter caught, the code was marked to ignore it.

testRemoval.title: Removed a test instead of fixing it
testRemoval.subtitle: A failing test was skipped or deleted rather than repaired.

testQuality.title: Tests that pass without proving anything
testQuality.subtitle: They run and go green, but they cannot catch a defect.

dependency.title: Packages that do not exist, or look wrong
dependency.subtitle: Attackers pre-register package names that AI tends to invent — this attack is already happening.

scopeAndDeletion.title: Changes and deletions outside what was claimed
scopeAndDeletion.subtitle: What the commit message declared and what actually changed do not match.

codebaseContext.title: Relationship to the existing code
codebaseContext.subtitle: New code that duplicates something already here, is never called, or breaks callers elsewhere.

agentSession.title: What the agent actually did
agentSession.subtitle: The process behind the final diff. Only checked when a session log exists.

execution.title: Whether it actually ran
execution.subtitle: Did the tests run against this exact state, and were the changed lines executed at all?

reviewTools.title: Tools that assist the review
reviewTools.subtitle: Not detections — these change how you review rather than what gets flagged.

other.title: Uncategorised checks
other.subtitle: Checks that do not belong to any group yet.

detail.staticDiff: Not covered by the diff scan
detail.syntax: Not covered by the syntax scan
